visualRisks.description: Water and road colors are very similar, which could cause confusion.
visualRisks.suggestion: Consider using more distinct colors for water and roads.

visualRisks.description: The lighthouse is not easily distinguishable against the ground color.
visualRisks.suggestion: Increase contrast between the lighthouse and the ground.

navigationRisks.description: There are no clear visual indicators for the start or end of the route, which could confuse players.
navigationRisks.suggestion: Add markers at the beginning and end of the route to guide players.

navigationRisks.description: The route path is not clearly defined in the grid, making it hard for players to follow.
navigationRisks.suggestion: Ensure that the route path stands out more in the grid design.
